September 17, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):

GREAT PEOPLE'S ASSOCIATION TO BROADCAST

To-day the Shanghai United Branch of the Great
People's Association will broadcast through the Greater
Shanghai Radio Station an address on the following subject:
"Greater unity among the peoples of East Asia can be
effected when the influence of white people has been
removed."

Made by. D.I. Ian Hien-pih.    Forwarded by. .........

（批：Sec + C G）
（印：... OFFICE ...）
（批：The Reluctant）
E.

Copies of a questionnaire, a translation of
which is attached, are in course of distribution by
the Great Peoples Society through its branch offices
to the public in the Japanese occupied areas.
The campaign which is styled "Test for People
in connection with the Peace and National Salvation
Movement" commenced on August 1st.
The questionnaire contains a set of twelve
questions which must be answered from the viewpoint
of Japanese policy. Those taking answers which
show that they are not fully appreciative of what
is required of them by the Authorities in question,
will be ordered to rewrite the answers to conform
with the doctrine of the Society.
Of the twelve questions, Nos.5, 9, 10 and
11 are the most important and are enumerated below
together with the answers which are expected to be
given :
5. (Q) Are Great Britain and Soviet Russia helpful
or harmful to China ?
(A) Both Great Britain and Soviet Russia are
harmful to China.
9. (Q) Who can be the President of New China ?
(A) Wang Ching Wei can be the President of
New China.
10. (Q) Is it necessary to take back the Settlements ?
(A) All Settlements must be recovered.

大同社正通过其分支机构向日占区的公众分发问卷副本，译文附后。
这项名为“和平救国运动民众测试”的活动于8月1日开始。
问卷包含十二个问题，必须从日本政策的角度作答。那些回答显示其未能充分领会有关当局要求的人，将被责令重写答案以符合该社的教义。
在十二个问题中，第5、9、10和11题最为重要，现列举如下，并附上预期给出的答案：
5. （问）英国和苏俄对中国是有益还是有害？
（答）英国和苏俄均对中国有害。
9. （问）谁能成为新中国的总统？
（答）汪精卫可以成为新中国的总统。
10. （问）是否有必要收回租界？
（答）所有租界必须收回。

REPORT
Date July 17, 1939.
Subject. Great People Society - First Anniversary of Inauguration
- Celebration in Pootung
Made by D.I. Fan Lien-pik Forwarded by C. Gonsalvo S.T

In celebration of the 1st anniversary of the
inauguration of the Great People Society, a pro-
Japanese organization with headquarters at Nanking,
a meeting of so-called "Shanghai citizens in favour
of the peace and national salvation movement against
communism and the British" was held under the
auspices of the Pootung Branch of the Society on
July 15 on the premises of the Kwai Yang Theatre
(淮揚新舞臺), 452 Tung Chong Road, Pootung.
Present at the meeting were some 2,000 persons from
various villages in Pootung who are said to have been
coerced by the Pootung District Administrative Office
on the pain of a fine of $2.00.

The proceedings commenced at 10 a.m., July 15,
and were presided over by CHU TING (朱亭), Chief
of the Pootung Branch of the Great People Society.
After announcing the object of the meeting, CHU TING
delivered a strong speech against the Communism and the
British. He alleged that Great Britain was
responsible for disruption in peaceful condition
and also responsible for the financial assistance
accorded General CHIANG KAI SHEK. In order to
attain permanent peace, Great Britain should be
overthrown and all her interests in China be
eliminated.

The next speakers were TSUI NGOH TSUNG
(朱玉松), Chief of the Pootung District

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 18 JULY 1939）

制作人 督察 范连璧（Fan Lien-pik） 转呈人 C. Gonsalvo S.T

为庆祝总部设在南京的亲日组织大同社成立一周年，7月15日，在该社浦东分社的主持下，在浦东通中路452号淮扬新舞台（Kwai Yang Theatre）举行了一次所谓的“上海市民拥护反共反英和平救国运动”会议。出席会议的有来自浦东各村的约2000人，据说他们是受浦东区行政公署胁迫而来，否则将面临2.00美元的罚款。

会议于7月15日上午10时开始，由大同社浦东分社社长朱亭（CHU TING）主持。在宣布会议目的后，朱亭发表了强烈的反共和反英演讲。他声称英国应对破坏和平局面负责，也应对给予蒋介石将军的财政援助负责。为了实现永久和平，应该推翻英国并消除其在华的所有利益。

接下来的发言者是朱玉松（TSUI NGOH TSUNG），浦东区

Made by D.I. Ian Lien-pih Forwarded by C Claesfeld. J.

The local Great People Society will celebrate
the 1st anniversary of the inauguration of the
society by the holding of a mass meeting in the .
Wei Yang ( 淮揚 ) Theatre, Tung Chong Road, Pootung
at 9 a.m. July 15, 1939. This meeting will be
named "The Shanghai Citizens' Propaganda Meeting
for the Salvation of the Nation by promoting Peace."
The Headquarters of the Society in Nanking
will hold a celebration on a large scale in Nanking
the same day.

It is learned that preparations are being made
by the Great People Society (大民会), a Japanese
sponsored organization, to celebrate the 1st anniversary
of its inauguration which falls on the 15th July, 1939.
(The programme has not yet been ascertained).

The Headquarters of the Great People Society was
formally inaugurated on July 15, 1938 in the New Asia
Hotel, North Szechuen and Tiendong Roads. The Chief of
the Society is one Kao Soh (高朔). After the
removal of the headquarters of the Society to Nanking
at the end of October, 1938, a Shanghai Office was
established at 427 East Seward Road and Li Yoeh Chin
(李王崑) was appointed to take charge. At the
beginning of January 1939, a Shanghai Joint Office of
the Society was inaugurated at No.22 Columbia Road,
with one Huang Vee (黄维) in charge.

According to the regulations of the Society,
the Headquarters of the society consists of four
departments which are as follows:-
1. Secretariat.
2. Organization Department.
3. General Affairs Department.
4. Publicity Department.

A number of joint offices which are to be established
in the leading cities of the various provinces will be
directly responsible to the Headquarters and under the
joint office there will be a number of branches, which

获悉，由日本扶植的组织“大民会”正在准备庆祝其成立于1939年7月15日的一周年纪念日。（具体日程尚未确定）。

大民会总部于1938年7月15日在北四川路和天潼路交界处的新亚酒店正式成立。该会会长为高朔 (音译)。在1938年10月底大民会总部迁往南京后，在东熙华德路427号设立了上海办事处，并指派李玉崑（原文作Li Yoeh Chin (李王崑)）负责。1939年1月初，该会在哥伦比亚路22号成立了上海联合办事处，由黄维 (音译，原文作Huang Vee) 负责。

根据该会章程，该会总部由以下四个部门组成：
1. 秘书处。
2. 组织部。
3. 总务部。
4. 宣传部。

将在各省主要城市设立的若干联合办事处将直接对总部负责，联合办事处之下将设有若干分会，

The Society claims as its object (1) the revival and practice of the "People's Moral Principles" aiming at promoting Chinese ancient moral principles and creating a new Chinese national spirit; (2) serving as a medium between the people and the Government; (3) reformation of the life of the people in order to increase the national strength; and (4) endeavouring to bring about a Sino-Japanese rapprochement as a fundamental step towards the independence and prosperity of the Orient. In point of fact, however, the society is nothing more or less than an instrument of the Japanese and pro-Japanese Chinese authorities and their hirelings for the cultivation of pro-Japanese thoughts among the Chinese people in the name of peace, while at the same time serving as a base from which anti-British propaganda

organization engaged in the propagation of anti-
British, anti-Comintern and anti-Chiang Kai-shek

With regard to the manner in which the propaganda
of the Great People Society is carried on, apart from
the dissemination of posters and pamphlets and broad-
casting over the radio, there is also an organization
known as the mobile propaganda corps, whose duties it
is to spread far and wide anti-Chiang Kai-shek and pro-
Japanese propaganda in the various occupied areas. In
the past it has been noted, however, that propaganda
of anti-British and anti-foreign nature has been
distributed by the society without revealing the true
source of origin. From time to time the names of
fictitious organizations are used in the dissemination
of propaganda, which, it is believed, has been held
by the sponsors of the society as a necessary step
in order to avoid giving rise to issues of an inter-
national character.
In the headquarters of the Society in Nanking
there is a Compiling and Publishing Committee to which
is entrusted the work of issuing, on various occasions,
pamphlets and handbills required for propaganda purposes
and the compiling and publishing of periodical and non-
periodical publications. At present the Compiling and
Publishing Committee issues a Chinese monthly periodical
magazine entitled "Hsin Chung Kuo Monthly" (New China
